summary: No disagreement was found: Node 22.22.1, npm 11.21.1 and PostgreSQL 18.6 agree in every copy, so nothing in .github/ or deploy/ was touched. No .env.example line had to be added, because NODE_ENV is the only name read and not documented, and it is on a named exemption list. The brief's A, B, C and D are all done. A: repo-config.spec.ts has three new checks. (1) The names read in config/env.ts equal the names in .env.example, with commented lines counted; the VITE_* names are compared with their one reader in src/frontend/src/api.ts. (2) The Node, npm and PostgreSQL versions are the same in every copy, and a failure names the files. (3) Every dependency and devDependency in the three package.json files is an exact x.y.z. B: logWithStack is exported once from failure-kind.ts and used by logFailure and by NotificationsService.logFailure. The logged texts are unchanged, and I added a spec for it. C: the root package.json has a `test:e2e` script, and the commands block of AGENTS.md and the README line use it. D: one sentence in the configuration row of architecture.md. Each check was shown to fail and then restored. Removing SESSION_TTL_DAYS from .env.example failed the settings check. .nvmrc at 22.22.2 failed the Node check. compose.yaml at postgres 18.7 failed the PostgreSQL check. A caret on pinia in the frontend package.json failed the pin check. I wrote no report.md because the Write tool refused the path; the report text is this summary plus the other fields.

lookTwice: The runtime check finds each version with a regex per file. If someone rewords the Stack line in AGENTS.md or the NODE_VERSION, NPM_VERSION or PG_IMAGE lines in setup.sh, the spec throws that the file does not state the version.
The settings check reads names with /\benv\.([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)/ in config/env.ts. A setting read some other way, such as a destructured process.env, would not be seen.
The README.md line for test:e2e was also changed to the one-word command. The brief did not name it, but it is the same command block.
